profile.name: A2D源测电源板
profile.description: 这是一块可编程电源与测量一体化电路板，可输出设定电压或电流，并测量电压、电流及板载温度。它适合实验室中用于为被测器件供电、进行基础电学表征、校准与板级调试。
profile.description_en: This is a programmable power and measurement board that can source a set voltage or current and measure voltage, current, and onboard temperature. It is suitable for laboratory use in powering devices under test, basic electrical characterization, calibration, and board-level debugging.

registry.name: A2 D Power
registry.description: A/D Power Board是由A/D Instruments生产的表征设备，主要功能包括初始化、复位、校准、测量、电压设置、电流设置。支持Signal, Slot, set i2c adc addr等操作。
